system.description:
You use your weapon to get around your opponent’s guard as they attack, and then bring it up in an attempt to disarm them, literally. You increase your AC by +2. If the triggering attack misses, you can make a melee taijutsu attack. On a hit you deal your [Weapons damage] + 3d8 and the triggering creature must make a Strength Saving throw. On a failed save, you disarm them of their weapon and take hold of it in an open hand. If you do not have a hand free, you throw it 10 feet in a direction of your choice.

Chain 1: This can be used against a ranged attack as well, where if the triggering attack misses, you can make a ranged taijutsu attack, and throw their attack back at them, making the triggering creature the new target for the jutsu’s attack and effects.

Chain 2: A creature who has their weapon disarmed from them is also knocked Prone.
